decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The extension shall be built in yellow 'London' Stock brickwork and roofed in slates to match the existing building.  The new roof to the outbuilding shall be faced with grey interlocking concret tiles

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The garage shall be used only for storage of vehicles ancillary to the ground floor shop or the first floor flat and shall not be used for any industrial or separate business, commercial or residential use.

Condition : 7 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions and due to appropriate design and position, the proposal would not harm the appearance of the building and the street scene or neighbours' living conditions. The proposal is in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Polices H.6.4, ENV-B.1.1 and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a first floor side and rear extension, and aterations to existing outbuilding to provide garage with hipped roof.
